visual.detailed_description: Three fused color-over-grayscale slices: A axial through the lumbar abdomen with a large rounded lesion with a thick red-orange uptake rim and yellow-white hot spots, B sagittal with a rim-uptake lesion above an irregular pelvic uptake mass, and C coronal with a large rim-uptake lesion, a smaller ring-shaped pelvic lesion and one focal very bright spot. panels.general_description: Axial fused PET-CT slice with a large rounded lesion with a glowing rim.
panels.detailed_description: Axial fused color-over-grayscale slice through the abdomen at lumbar level. A large rounded low-attenuation structure occupies the image right side with a thick red-orange rim of increased uptake and several yellow-white hot spots along the rim. Gas-containing bowel loops lie anteriorly and bowel with brighter contrast at the image left. A lumbar vertebra lies at the center with mild diffuse uptake. A letter A in a white box is at the upper right.
